scope: Development study of a different single-box instance: the frozen Math376 construction and every v2 recipe element (sampler seeds, model, normalization rule, Adam schedule, L-BFGS settings and 800-call budget, initialization bytes, engines, observer and physical limits) with the cutoff width doubled from 1/32 to 1/16. Motivation (Section 6.10, c36-pressure-structure-20261018.json): at 1/32 the cutoff layers alone keep the stratified corrected pressure 1.5-1.9 times over its limit; at 1/16 the layer forcing is 4-5 times (force) and 9-11 times (force gradient) smaller. This is a new, different instance, not a repair of the 1/32 problem, and is not compared with v1-v5 in the decision. Seeds 361901/361902 were trained on the 1/32 instance; no result here is a formal time-to-accuracy claim.

instance.changed_from_v1_v5: cutoff width eta only (source, training points, calibration, holdouts and model gate all use it)
instance.unchanged: box motion, viscosity, sampler seeds (training 795701, calibration 793701, holdouts 794701), region masses, point counts, model topology and features, scales rule, limits

absolute_tolerances_from_the_unchanged_l.note: pressure is normalized by the squared stratified velocity RMS, which falls with the wider cutoff: the absolute pressure tolerance is 0.65 times the 1/32 value while the layer forcing falls 4-5 times

instance.support: within [0.1875, 0.75] on every axis for t in [0, 1] (1/32: [0.25, 0.6875]); gate exactly zero at every initial, boundary and gauge point

feature_range_in_support_half_widths.note: same model features (relative position over half width, time); the wider support widens their range

generator_reproduction.result: at eta 1/32 the cutoff-width generators reproduce the frozen calibration and training source to at most 2.8e-14 of each array maximum (NumPy 2.4.6); sampled weights, regions, ids and targets identical; scales within 2.9e-16

qualification_before_submission.source_high_precision: calibration.json of eta 1/16: 10 saved calibration points pass the 80/160-digit mpmath checks (at most 2.3e-4 of the budget)

geometry.result: prepared 36-channel feature and gate states agree with fresh native coordinate AD on 88 region-stratified points (at most 2.7e-6 of the budget), chunking agrees, gate exactly zero at every value point

training.start: fresh original initialization; no direct-velocity checkpoints
training.stop_rule: none; the full budget runs and the first closure meeting both training limits is recorded with its parameters
training.engine: both: packed activation with analytic transpose, and parameter AD over the same packed forward; each compiled with CUDA Graph replay of the complete loss and gradient
training.gradient_reference: dense eager C36 parameter AD (chunk 128) at the original, changed and periodic parameters; fresh native coordinate AD of the complete objective on a subset (131 interior points of verify_potential_objective_gpu and every initial, boundary and gauge point, canonical denominators) at the original parameters. The preserved full native reference belongs to the 1/32 data and supplies only the stored initial parameter bytes; a full native reference costs about one H100 hour per seed.
training.trainer: box376.potential_train_v6 (potential_train_v2 with the reference checks above)

physical.state_observer: native coordinate AD of the trained curl-potential network

physical_observation.observer: box376.potential_physical_eta: the unchanged box376.potential_physical with its holdout builder and field evaluator bound to eta 1/16
physical_observation.observer_chunk_note: chunk 512 was selected for v5 by the registered rule (states within 1e-10 of their maximum against chunk 128 on 512 calibration points at eta 1/32); chunking does not change the arithmetic of a point
physical_observation.note: Per lane, final first. An observation starts only if the lane budget and the allocation deadline both allow its estimated duration; skipped observations are recorded.

decision_rule.scope: within this instance only; no ratio against v1-v5 enters the decision

outcomes_in_order.F1_pass: at least one run passes physical acceptance at an observed checkpoint
outcomes_in_order.F2_near_miss: no run passes, and some run's complete final observation exceeds no acceptance limit by more than 1.5 times
outcomes_in_order.F0_incomplete: no pass and no near miss, and some registered run lacks a complete final observation (failed or killed training, observation not run or failed)
outcomes_in_order.F3_fail: no pass and no near miss, with complete final observations of all four runs

follow_up.F1_pass: register a formal fresh-seed time-to-accuracy protocol on this instance with both engines
follow_up.F2_near_miss: no formal claim; a larger budget or capacity on this instance would need a new protocol
follow_up.F0_incomplete: no scientific reading; find and repair the cause before a new attempt
follow_up.F3_fail: no formal claim; the wider cutoff alone does not reach acceptance with this recipe

decision_rule.implementation: box376.decide_c36_v6 on the unchanged in-batch reader box376.read_c36_v2; synthetic tests box376.test_decide_c36_v6

execution.allocation: one new ACC node, 3 h, four H100 GPUs; one lane per (seed, engine), all four concurrent
execution.node_count_reason: four single-GPU lanes (two seeds x two engines); the smallest node count that runs all four at once
execution.start_command: embedded in the batch script; the cluster-side driver box376.run_c36_v6 runs admission, training, observation, reader, decision and archive
execution.storage: work root on project storage with every compiler and temporary cache inside the batch directory

paired_development_analysis.statistic: per seed, parameter_ad/analytic ratios of training seconds to first reach loss 1e-3, 3e-4 and 1e-4, and of mean seconds per evaluation
paired_development_analysis.status: development only: seeds trained before on the 1/32 instance, two concurrent lanes per engine on one node; not a formal time-to-accuracy result
